the-code:
📜 **THE JABBAZI CODE**

**PRICE > PICK**
A team can win and still have been a bad bet at the price.

**EDGE > HYPE**
We want defensible probabilities and favorable prices, not excitement.

**DISCIPLINE > CHASING**
Losses do not change the mathematics of the next wager.

**PROCESS > ONE RESULT**
One win proves very little. One loss proves very little. Evaluate decisions over meaningful samples using expected value, closing-line value, calibration, model performance, pricing discipline and bankroll control.

**NO FORCED PLAYS**
WATCH and PASS are legitimate outcomes. If the price is gone, the play is gone.

**THE GOAL**
Make repeatable, evidence-based decisions with a reasonable chance of demonstrating sustainable edge over time.

**Built on Edge. Not Hype. 👑**

*JABBAZI · Channel guide*
how-to-use-jabbazi:
📖 **HOW JABBAZI WORKS**

🟢 **BET NOW** — the current price meets the criteria for an official issued position.
🟡 **WATCH** — interesting, but price, information or model confidence is not sufficient yet.
🔵 **PRICE CHECK** — playable only at or better than a specific number.
⚪ **PASS** — no acceptable edge at the available price.
🔴 **QUARANTINED** — the model or market is not trusted for betting approval.

**Main Card** — official issued JABBAZI positions.
**Research** — information used to evaluate opportunities; not automatically a play.
**Sprinkles** — lower-priority/user-choice exposure kept separate from the official card.
**Play-To Price** — the worst price JABBAZI is willing to accept. Do not chase beyond it.
**Units** — follow the active bankroll policy; never resize simply because of recent wins or losses.

Official plays live in #main-card.

jabbazi-main-card:
👑 **JABBAZI MAIN CARD**

This channel contains official issued JABBAZI positions only.

A valid Main Card post should include as much of the following as available:
• event and market
• sportsbook / best available price
• observed odds
• play-to price
• unit size
• model probability
• market/no-vig probability
• estimated edge
• material risks
• observation time

**Do not chase a price past the stated play-to number.**

If a number moves outside the approved range, check #live-watch or #line-moves. Research posts, model candidates and member plays are not official JABBAZI positions unless explicitly issued here.

**The card is the record. 👑**

parlays:
🎲 **JABBAZI PARLAYS**

Parlays are evaluated differently from straight bets.

Every added leg compounds estimation error, increases variance, may introduce hidden correlation and usually increases sportsbook hold.

A parlay belongs here only when each leg is defensible, the combined price is verified, correlation is understood, expected value is acceptable and exposure fits bankroll rules.

A fun parlay is not automatically an official JABBAZI parlay.

*JABBAZI · Channel guide*
vip-research:
🧠 **WELCOME TO THE LAB**

This is where JABBAZI research happens before a position earns Main Card status.

We evaluate model probability, market probability, no-vig price, injuries, weather, lineups, matchup context, price movement, alternate markets, props, correlations and uncertainty.

A model output is evidence. It is not automatically approval to bet.

The final question is not **“Who wins?”**

It is:

**“Is the available price better than our defensible estimate of fair value?”**

bankroll:
💰 **BANKROLL DISCIPLINE**

Your bankroll exists to survive variance.

Do not:
• increase units because you lost
• chase losses
• double stakes to “get even”
• treat parlays as safe because they contain favorites
• risk money needed for bills or essentials

Unit sizing should be determined by bankroll and edge quality, not emotion.

*JABBAZI · Channel guide*

clv-tracker:
📉 **CLOSING-LINE VALUE**

Closing-line value compares the price we obtained with the market near close.

Example:
JABBAZI enters **-110**
Market closes **-135**

That is favorable movement.

CLV is not perfect and does not guarantee profit. But consistent positive CLV across a meaningful sample can be important evidence that the process is identifying favorable prices.
